rate_limits: Rate limited; begin with a handful of requests per second, handle HTTP 429, and use retry with exponential backoff; exact thresholds vary or are unpublished.
resolution_notes: rate_limits: auditor correct. Official Web APIs Overview (https://www.rcsb.org/docs/programmatic-access/web-apis-overview) states all RCSB PDB APIs are rate-limited, recommends starting with a handful of requests per second, returns HTTP 429 on excess, and advises short waits/exponential backoff; no universal numeric ceiling is published on that page. Original 'not published' understated this guidance.
